changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ResourceGroup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[ResourceGroup]( [ResourceID] [int] NOT NULL, [GroupID] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ResourceGroup] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ResourceID] ASC, [GroupID] ASC ) )
END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_ResourceGroup_Group') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[ResourceGroup] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_ResourceGroup_Group] FOREIGN KEY([GroupID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Group] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[ResourceGroup] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_ResourceGroup_Group] END
